steps.description: Build modern minimalist layout with clean alignment for displaying and editing the count value.

steps.description: Add the numeric display area with high-contrast text sizing to view counts clearly.

steps.description: Incorporate increment, decrement, and clear action controls in the XML template layout.

steps.description: Write MainActivity.java in package com.tinycounter.app utilizing basic Android SDK classes.

steps.description: Bind layout components using standard findViewById API references inside onCreate.

steps.description: Implement calculation limits allowing subtraction of numbers and basic state boundaries.

steps.description: Validate the XML elements and check the strict root attribute schemas for compliance.

steps.title: Building Tiny Counter
